text:
inc-bot: ALERT: failed to deliver page to oncall for service 'routing-orch' (timeout) — created INC-4321
Alex: seeing repeated timeouts from incident-bot, pages not reaching phone :iphone_off: 
Maria: checked notify-proxy logs — a bunch of 502s starting ~09:02 UTC, looks like header parse error
Sam: Tilly didn't get a page, can someone call her? @Tilly
Tilly: didn't receive page, I'm oncall and available
Alex: placing manual call now
Maria: investigating — found this in logs: `ERROR parse_auth_header: invalid token format` from notify-proxy-3
Maria: attempting a restart of notify-proxy-3 (k8s) to clear transient auth state
inc-bot: deploybot: restart job queued for pod notify-proxy-3
Sam: manual call completed, Tilly acked via phone
Tilly: acked, now following runbook steps for routing-orch incident
Maria: restart done — services responded, 502s gone, pages resuming to some oncall endpoints
Alex: can we add a short suppress window to avoid duplicate pages while we stabilize? :thumbsup:
Maria: adding 10m suppressor rule for incoming pages to incident queue now
Sam: CS/Support notified about potential delayed paging for a subset of customers earlier today
Tilly: good to capture customer impact in the incident notes — any idea how many customers were affected?
Maria: initial query shows ~4% of paging events failed between 09:02–09:08 UTC, I'll dump a csv and attach to postmortem
Alex: capturing action items — restart fixed immediate issue, need fix in auth header parsing, add more robust fallback, and add better alerting on notify-proxy 502 spikes
Sam: I'll draft customer comms and link to the incident doc
Tilly: reassign follow-ups: @Maria owns root-cause patch, @Sam owns customer comms, @Alex will write the postmortem
inc-bot: Incident INC-4321 resolved (auto) — resolution: restart of notify-proxy + temporary suppressor rule applied. Follow-ups assigned.
